name: fishball-shared
//: A library, not a DSH plugin (R-ARCH-08, design §9.1): no `dsh` field, so no bundle, row, client or service, and it never appears on a Plugins page. It is the Fishball side's library (requirements 1.40, design §1.0b row 5): it holds only modules Fishball-side packages use (today fishball-core alone; fishball-ui and fishball-board may join, R-ARCH-08), imports no other V3 package, and ships inside their tarballs through bundleDependencies (V3 publishes nothing to a registry). The DSH side has its own library, dsh-connector-shared; no module is shared across the sides.
description: The Fishball side's library: file helpers, the OAuth browser client core's Connect runs on (./oauth-client), and, until I-HOST, core's copies of the child admin protocol and the provider-sync codec, engine and host adapter.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation, as for fishball-core: './provider-sync-codec' reads the DSH version and './provider-sync-host' adapts the pi-ai provider settings. '*' because the depending package's engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.
//TODO: I-HOST (v3-remaining-plan §5): ./admin-protocol, ./provider-sync, ./provider-sync-codec and ./provider-sync-host (with redact.js, which provider-sync-host imports) are the Fishball side's interim copies of dsh-connector-shared's, kept only for core's child halves (src/slim/child/admin.js, provider-sync-target.js). I-HOST moves those halves into dsh-instance's child-side row; delete these copies then.
